{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is int, then sort and drop duplicates
# Convert sample_seq to int if needed
df['sample_seq'] = pd.to_numeric(df['sample_seq'], errors='coerce')

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to ensure highest sample_seq comes first
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (highest sample_seq)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now check the number of sites
print(df_dedup['site'].unique())
print(len(df_dedup['site'].unique()))"}
